data.content_ref: inline:05a4074c795b abstracts SRC_001 and SRC_004 by replacing their concrete obstruction structures (matching cuts, induced stable cycles, local minima) with a general random-landscape model: consensus probability is the probability that a random start avoids all reachable local minima, each weighted by basin measure. Refuted if the basin-weighted count of reachable local minima is not the sufficient statistic for consensus probability, or if static obstructions and dynamical traps require separate non-combinable parameters.
